# Agentic First

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## What This Repo Owns

This repo owns the top-level Agentic First route map. It routes users and
agents into two deliberately separate areas:

- Companies: a source-owned profile mechanism and live MCP service where
  companies publish correct information on their own domain so agents can use
  it without scraping or paying a data broker.
- Tony's Agentics Tool Directory: Tony Wood's working directory of
  agent-friendly tools, field notes, useful experiments, and things worth
  tracking.

## Product Areas

- Companies: https://agentic-first.co/companies/
- Company/profile MCP: https://agentic-first.co/companies/mcp
- Company/profile machine index: https://agentic-first.co/companies/llms.txt
- Tony's Agentics Tool Directory: https://agentic-first.co/directory/
- Tool Directory machine index: https://agentic-first.co/directory/llms.txt
- Product source: https://github.com/yqup/pitch-mcp
